subject: English
passage: Geologists Marie and Pierre Dubois systematically examined archival records of ground movements in Earth's crust known as seismic tremors. Their research in the early 1900s led to the documentation of a period from 1750 to 1820—now known as the Dubois ______ tremors were remarkably infrequent, a pattern that seismologists continue to analyze.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of paired em-dashes to set off an appositive phrase. An em-dash opens the appositive phrase 'now known as the Dubois Quiescence,' and a second em-dash must close it before the sentence continues. The closing em-dash before 'when' creates the structure: 'a period from 1750 to 1820—now known as the Dubois Quiescence—when tremors were remarkably infrequent.'
